run_extract_image_feature: run the extract_image_feature script to load and extract image features for a ParlAI task
run_extract_image_feature_coco: run extract_image_feature with --task vqa_v1 --image-mode resnet152 to extract COCO image features
extract_feats_function: call extract_feats with an opt dict to extract image features through a RepeatLabelAgent world loop
setup_args_parser: call setup_args to create a ParlaiParser configured for loading and extracting image features
ExtractImgFeatures_class: instantiate ExtractImgFeatures as a ParlaiScript subclass to run image feature extraction via CLI
